source.text: A case with one fault: a contact penalty factor of 10, which gave a pressure eleven times too large with nothing in OFFBEAT's log to say so. FEED must refuse it before any run; SEED reports E_OUT_OF_RANGE.
source.check: FEED's schema vectors (schema/vectors/bad/mechanics-penalty-too-high.json) assert the same code in FEED's own test suite.
